newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks hit new highs, bull run to last.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks hit new highs, bull run to last.

text.p: Croatian stocks extended their gains on Wednesday, hitting new highs, and traders said the upward trend would last for some time to come.
"Almost all stocks rose beyond all expectations," a trader at Metroholding brokerage said, adding that the new market vigour could be ascribed to a variety of factors.
"Record-highs of (drugs firm) Pliva's and Zagrebacka Banka's GDRs in London were certainly among most positive impulses (influencing the market)," he said.
He also said it was mostly small investors who were giving a boost to shares in confectioner Kras.
* Of nine active issues, eight rose and one fell.
* The biggest gainer Pliva jumped 300 kuna, closing at 12,500 and selling 316 shares. Its GDRs, representing 1/50 of each share, fetched $49.5 in London.
* Zagrebacka gained 57 kuna to close at 847, on volume of 2,829 shares. Its GDRs, issued at 10 to each share, rose to $17.685 from Tuesday's $16.25 on Seaq International in London.
* Confectioner Kras rose 31 kuna to 430, with 339 shares changing hands.
- Jadranturist added 15 kuna to 200, with 955 shares sold.
- Riviera 16 kuna to 105, on volume of 520 units.
- Suncani Hvar five kuna to 45, trading 410 units.
* Electric cables manufacturer Elka added 12 kuna to 147, trading 499 shares.
* Food processor Podravka was the only loser, dipping five kuna to 225, after peaking at 240 during the session. It was the most actively traded issue with 7,312 shares sold.
* Volume higher at 13,374 shares, daily turnover slightly up at 8.6 million kuna.
